name: openclaw-master-skills
description: 🧠 Curated collection of 1209+ best OpenClaw skills — weekly updated by MyClaw.ai
summary: 1209 项精选的 OpenClaw 技能合集，由 MyClaw.ai 每周更新
categoryDescription: 官方或社区维护的 Skills、插件与资源目录
categoryReason: 名称或作者描述明确说明是目录/合集
howToUse: 先在仓库目录中选择目标 Skill，再按 README 将对应目录复制或安装到你的 Agent Skills 目录。
installCommand:
clawhub install openclaw-master-skills
git clone https://github.com/LeoYeAI/openclaw-master-skills.git
cp -r openclaw-master-skills/skills/<skill-name> ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/
